sections.heading: Turn filed paperwork into queryable information
sections.body:
textIQ brings intelligent search and insight to unstructured enterprise content. Using NLP and Generative AI, it supports extraction, classification and summarisation over unstructured documents, turning filed paperwork into fields a system can query.

For organisations working with unstructured enterprise documents, textIQ is part of our [Data & AI](/services/data-ai) portfolio.
